shown.message:
I changed nothing this turn. `story-repo` revised the `Outline` to record the P7 result, inconclusive, but `experiment-repo` has not yet delivered the table behind it. The paper's numbers come only from delivered tables, so I haven't written it in.

The text already calls the noise-adjusted S score exploratory, and the verdict stays "no evidence of a useful data-computable bias score". When the P7 table lands I'll add one appendix paragraph and a Table 2 row.

The GNN and cluster Horvitz–Thompson tables, the P6 results and the `design.tex`/`discussion.tex` "not run" sentences are still waiting on `experiment-repo`.
